entities.summary: Bent Egsmark Christensen is a Danish football coach and former player who is the head coach of Odder IGF. In his active career, Christensen played as a midfielder, who spent his career with Værløse BK, Lyngby FC and BSC Young Boys, and played four games for the Denmark national football team.
